figure_candidates.label: Figure 1
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 1. BPI alkaloids and their proposed biosynthetic pathway. (a) Structural diversity of the three main type BPI alkaloids: BPI diketopiperazine
(BPI-DKP), BPI epipolythiodiketopiperazine (BPI-ETP) and chimonanthine-type BPI alkaloids (BPI core highlighted in color), and representative
BPI-DKP alkaloids. (b) Simplified mechanistic proposal for P450-catalyzed DKP dimerization during BPI core assembly*.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Function analysis of TtpB1. (a) Substrate specificity screening of TtpB1. (b) Sequence alignment of the I-helix of TtpB1, AspB
(NasS1868), other DKP dimerases, and well-characterized CYPs (P450cam). “Acid-alcohol pair” (highlighted in black frame). (c) Architectural
features of I-helix proton delivery residues. An Asp/Glu facilitates initial protonation of the peroxo-anion distal oxygen, while a Thr/Ser assists the
second protonation, enabling O−O bond cleavage and H2O release to form Cpd I. (d) Relative activities of the enzyme reactions of TtpB1, and it is
Ser242, Glu241 mutants with 2 in the NADPH-based system. Error bars indicate standard deviation from three independent replicates system. (e)
Initial velocities of 1 formation by TtpB1 in H2O (blue) and D2O (Green) in NADPH based system. Error bars indicate standard deviation from
three independent replicates system. (f) Biochemical assay of TtpB1 using H2O2 as oxygen surrogate with substrate 2.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Structural analysis of TtpB1, 2Fo−Fc electron density maps (blue color mesh, contoured at 1.8 σ) of 3. (a) Crystal structure of TtpB1 in
complex with one 2 (yellow) molecule. (b) Crystal structure of TtpB1 in complex with two 3 molecules. (c) 2Fo−Fc electron density maps (blue
color mesh, contoured at 1.8 σ) of 3 in the active site of TtpB1 (Sub2-L, Sub1-U; L and U indicate extended and U-shaped, respectively). (d)
Crystal structure of TtpB1 in complex with two 3 molecules and its active sites. (e) Mutational analysis of key amino acids identified by molecular
dynamics (MD) simulations, relative activities of the enzyme reactions of TtpB1 and its Ala237, Phe80, Trp189, Leu175 mutants with 2 in
NADPH-based. N.D.: Not detected. Error bars indicate standard deviation from three independent replicates.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. QM/MM-calculated energy profile (in kcal/mol) and structures for Cpd I-mediated H-abstraction from diketopiperazine N12−H to
form intermolecular C3−C3′ bond. The spin population of the key atoms is also given. The key distances are given in Å. For clarity, only relevant
hydrogen atoms were shown.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 5
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 5. Mechanistic analysis of substrate conformational dynamics and reaction pathway. (a) QM/MM-calculated energy profile (in kcal/mol)
and structures for the following reactions from Int1a. The spin population of the key atoms is also given. The key distances are given in Å. For
clarity, only relevant hydrogen atoms were shown. (b) Relative enzymatic activities of TtpB1 and Glu315 mutants (proposed proton acceptors)
with substrate 2 in NADPH-dependent reactions. N.D.: Not detected. Error bars indicate standard deviation from three independent replicates.
